description: local-ollama.json with Mistral AI's mistral:7b-instruct as coder A, to compare models on the same responses. Every role on models served by Ollama on this machine: no key, no cost, no respondent text leaves the machine (ADR-0049). Coder A mistral:7b-instruct (Mistral AI), coder B, the judge and the refactorer gemma4:12b (Google). Pull first: ollama pull mistral:7b-instruct gemma4:12b embeddinggemma
